summary: This short note introduces the women's super-G event in alpine skiing at the 1998 Winter Olympics. It names the two pre-Games favourites by their titles: the defending world champion and the defending World Cup super-G champion. The note contains no results or other details.
one_line: Preview note on the women's super-G at the 1998 Winter Olympic alpine skiing, naming the defending champions.
key_facts: The event was the women's super-G in alpine skiing at the 1998 Winter Olympics.
The defending world champion in women's super-G was Isolde Kostner of Italy.
Hilde Gerg of Germany was the defending World Cup Super G champion.
